decisions.reason: As a newly launched camera close to the core business, it preserves a low-cost option in a growing space market and there is too little negative evidence after one year to justify withdrawal.
A modular product line with several models signals stronger commitment and flexibility for different missions, so keeping it open is a valuable option with limited abandonment pressure.
Although somewhat more exploratory than the standard camera products, it still builds on existing capabilities and the firm can afford to wait for demand and mission opportunities to become clearer.

Its weaker website presence suggests a less mature offer and somewhat higher chance of exit, but miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR fits the firm's strategic direction closely enough that management would likely keep the option alive for now.
